name: metaai-reversed
description: Node.js library that talks to meta.ai's private web endpoints (anonymous / authenticated chat, Thinking mode, web search, vision, image generation) by reconstructing the browser's DGW WebSocket + protobuf protocol.
author: myounis1996 (https://github.com/myounis1996)

scripts.lint: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const walk=(d)=>!fs.existsSync(d)?[]:fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);const files=['index.js',...walk('src'),...walk('tests'),...walk('examples')];let bad=0;for(const f of files){try{cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:['ignore','ignore','pipe']})}catch(e){bad++;console.error('SYNTAX ERROR '+f+'\n'+String(e.stderr))}}console.log((files.length-bad)+'/'+files.length+' files parsed');process.exit(bad?1:0)"
scripts.smoke: node -e "const lib=require('./');const need=['AnonChat','AuthChat','AuthImageGen','ImageGenRefusalError','CookieJar','MODES','openTurn','buildRequest','readResponse','ResponseState','uploadAttachment'];const missing=need.filter((k)=>!(k in lib));if(missing.length){console.error('missing exports: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('package loads — '+Object.keys(lib).length+' exports')"
